newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed amid shrinking volume.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed amid shrinking volume.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed with some new losses in hotelier issues and blue chips holding ground amid shrinking volume on Thursday.
* Four of 10 traded issues flat, three up, three down.
* Volume lower at 19,515 units, turnover 18.5 million kuna.
* Biggest decliner, Arenaturist, fell 85 kuna to 155 on volume of 85 shares.
* Top gainer Varazdinska Banka up to 714 from 442 kuna in August. It sold 40 shares.
* Most active Zagrebacka Banka with 18,209 units flat at 1,000 kuna.
